import HartshorneLib.Chapter4CurveDifferentialLattice
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4ResidueDegree
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Nakayama
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.FreeModule.Finite.Basic

/-!
# Differentials of local parameters

The differential of every local parameter on a smooth curve over an
algebraically closed field generates its local differential module. The
resulting frame is specified by the parameter and depends on it. This is the
local normalization needed before constructing residues of differentials.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

namespace Hartshorne

open IsLocalRing

/-- If the residue field is generated by the coefficient ring and the maximal
ideal is generated by `t`, then finite Kahler differentials are generated by
`dt`. -/
theorem span_differential_eq_top_of_maximalIdeal_eq_span
    {k R : Type*} [CommRing k] [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite R Ω[R⁄k]]
    (hres : Function.Surjective ((residue R).comp (algebraMap k R)))
    (t : R) (ht : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span {t}) :
    Submodule.span R {KaehlerDifferential.D k R t} = ⊤ := by
  apply top_le_iff.mp
  apply Submodule.le_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson_bot
    (I := maximalIdeal R) Module.Finite.fg_top
    (by rw [jacobson_eq_maximalIdeal _ bot_ne_top])
  conv_lhs => rw [← KaehlerDifferential.span_range_derivation k R]
  apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
  rintro _ ⟨r, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hres (residue R r)
  have hmem : r - algebraMap k R c ∈ maximalIdeal R := by
    rw [← residue_eq_zero_iff, map_sub]
    change residue R (algebraMap k R c) = residue R r at hc
    exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hc.symm
  rw [ht, Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at hmem
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hmem
  have hr : r = algebraMap k R c + a * t := by
    rw [ha]
    ring
  have htmem : t ∈ maximalIdeal R := by
    rw [ht]
    exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton t)
  rw [hr, map_add, Derivation.map_algebraMap, zero_add, Derivation.leibniz]
  exact Submodule.add_mem_sup
    ((Submodule.span R {KaehlerDifferential.D k R t}).smul_mem a
      (Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton _)))
    (Submodule.smul_mem_smul htmem (Submodule.mem_top))

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverAlgebra stalkOverAlgebra
  stalkFunctionFieldOver_isScalarTower

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
variable (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom]

/-- The differential of every local parameter generates the differential
module of a smooth curve at a closed point. -/
theorem span_curveStalkDifferential_of_irreducible
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t) :
    Submodule.span (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
      {KaehlerDifferential.D k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) t} = ⊤ := by
  letI := smoothCurve_stalk_isDiscreteValuationRing X.hom hx
  letI := (smoothCurve_stalkDifferentials_free_rank_one X x).1
  let b := Module.basisUnique Unit
    (Module.finrank_eq_of_rank_eq (smoothCurve_stalkDifferentials_free_rank_one X x).2)
  letI := Module.Finite.of_basis b
  letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (X.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom)
  letI : Smooth (X.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
    SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth 1 _
  letI : Module k (X.left.residueField x) := X.left.residueFieldOverModule k x
  letI := Scheme.residueDeg_finite (K := k) hx
  letI : Algebra k (X.left.residueField x) :=
    (X.left.residueOverAlgebraMap k x).toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra.IsIntegral k (X.left.residueField x) := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite k _
  have hres' : Function.Surjective (X.left.residueOverAlgebraMap k x) :=
    IsAlgClosed.algebraMap_bijective_of_isIntegral.surjective
  have hres : Function.Surjective ((residue (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)).comp
      (algebraMap k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x))) := hres'
  exact span_differential_eq_top_of_maximalIdeal_eq_span hres t ht.maximalIdeal_eq

/-- A local parameter has nonzero differential at a closed point of a smooth
curve. -/
theorem curveStalkDifferential_ne_zero_of_irreducible
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t) :
    KaehlerDifferential.D k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) t ≠ 0 := by
  intro hzero
  have hspan := span_curveStalkDifferential_of_irreducible X hx t ht
  have hz : ∀ η : CurveStalkDifferentials X x, η = 0 := by
    intro η
    have hη : η ∈ Submodule.span (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
        {KaehlerDifferential.D k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) t} :=
      hspan.symm ▸ Submodule.mem_top
    simpa [hzero] using hη
  have hrank := (smoothCurve_stalkDifferentials_free_rank_one X x).2
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := Module.one_le_rank_iff.mp hrank.ge
  exact one_ne_zero (hf ((hz (f 1)).trans (hz (f 0)).symm))

/-- Multiplication by `dt` identifies the local ring with its differential
module. The equivalence depends on the specified local parameter. -/
def curveStalkDifferentialEquivOfIrreducible
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t) :
    X.left.presheaf.stalk x ≃ₗ[X.left.presheaf.stalk x] CurveStalkDifferentials X x := by
  letI := (smoothCurve_stalkDifferentials_free_rank_one X x).1
  apply LinearEquiv.ofBijective
    (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (CurveStalkDifferentials X x)
      (KaehlerDifferential.D k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) t))
  constructor
  · exact LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp
      (LinearMap.ker_toSpanSingleton _
        (curveStalkDifferential_ne_zero_of_irreducible X hx t ht))
  · apply LinearMap.range_eq_top.mp
    rw [← LinearMap.span_singleton_eq_range]
    exact span_curveStalkDifferential_of_irreducible X hx t ht

@[simp]
theorem curveStalkDifferentialEquivOfIrreducible_apply
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t) (a : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) :
    curveStalkDifferentialEquivOfIrreducible X hx t ht a =
      a • KaehlerDifferential.D k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) t := rfl

end
end Hartshorne
